purpose: Contrast official 2011 Census urban geographies; these are not PIN or store catchments and do not support an investment decision.

cases.name: Bengaluru BBMP
limitations: Census 2011 is dated and is city-unit population, not a current store catchment.
No verified PIN crosswalk, local income proxy, footfall, competitors, or store economics are included.
HCES Karnataka urban apparel consumption is a regional survey benchmark and cannot be assigned as BBMP observed spend.
